name: Fortnite
subtitle: Tech UI Designer
description:
As a Tech UI Designer on Fortnite, I work at the intersection of art, design, and engineering, turning UI concepts into polished, performant screens inside Unreal Engine.
I create new UI materials directly in the editor, and build, implement, and improve widgets using Common UI, ViewModels, and Blueprints. Working closely with art and UX teams, I help bring new screens and features from mockup to in-game experience, making sure they look right, feel responsive, and are easy for other developers to maintain. I also collaborate with engineering teams to make sure my screens deliver great performance.

Responsibilities:
skills: Create new UI materials and shader effects in the Unreal Editor
Build, implement, and improve widgets using Common UI
Connect UI to game data using the ViewModel (MVVM) pattern
Script UI behavior and interactions with Blueprints
Partner with art and UX teams to create new screens from concept to implementation
Work together with engineering teams to optimize and refactor UI for performance and maintainability
Manage assets and changes with Perforce Helix Core
Use AI tools to speed up development workflows

name: Save System Structure with Thumbnails
description:
This plugin is a save system framework I developed using C++, Blueprints, and Common UI.
The plugin that uses C++ to generate runtime thumbnails asynchronously. It introduces an async node that waits for the render pipeline to finish, exports the render target to a file, and returns the file path.
With this system in place, I was able to build a foundation for a save system that makes it much easier for other developers to implement their own saving mechanisms with minimal setup.

Objectives:
skills: Demonstrate programming skills in C++
Show knowledge of the Unreal game Engine
Highlight problem solving with C++ skills
Demonstrate habillity to work with Common UI
Contribute to Indie Dev Community
